response: {"id": "DMS-REQ-0274", "title": "Alert Content", "specification": "The DMS shall be able to create an Alert for each detected DIASource. Each Alert shall include at least the following: a unique Alert identifier; the DIASource record that triggered the Alert; the DIAObject (or SSObject) record associated with the triggering DIASource, including the data needed to compute the light curve; up to 12 months of previous DIASource and DIAForcedSource records for the associated DIAObject; and cutout images (postage stamps) of the difference image and the template image centered on the DIASource, with their associated variance and mask information."}
